verdict.rationale: Kommo's docs describe a constructor for automatic system reactions to events such as lead stage changes and website visits. Integrators can add their own event handlers to the list of automatic actions, and a SalesBot visual editor builds automated scenarios. missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule conditions and action types, independent or hands-on corroboration of automation depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: The constructor enables you to set up automatic system reactions for events such as lead stage changes and website visits.
integrators can create their own event handlers and add them to the list of available automatic actions.
We provide a custom SalesBot language and visual editor to create automated scenarios for communicating with users.
